id.description: Canonical host identifier; primary key used by downstream joins.

ref.description: Source-native host reference. Keep for lineage; may match id.

systemId.description: Storage-system join key for per-system filtering and assembler partitioning.

hostTypeIndex.description: Collector-emitted host-type lookup key from the Lenovo.DE source payload.

hostTypeRef.description: Source-native host-type reference retained for lineage or join enrichment.

hostTypeName.description: Document-facing host type display name after collector-side lookup/enrichment.
